todos.title: P3 per-device badge state and payload protocol implementation
todos.description: Implement isolated fail-closed badge-state persistence, bindingId/revision assignment, bounded saturation, per-device payload construction, additive badge tuple/register fields, canonical protocol/schema/fixture updates, and iOS protocol mirror synchronization.
todos.notes: Canonical protocol must land in MacBridge before the iOS mirror; docs changes require immediate per-repo commits.

verification.summary: New go-bridge/web_push_badge.go: per-device badge state (bindingId wpb_<22b64url>, uint64 revision, unreadSessions map keyed by sessionAggregationKey, saturated at 4096 distinct keys, count capped 0..999) persisted in separate web-push-badge-state.json (0600 atomic, corruption disables badge only). RegisterWithBinding handles binding lifecycle (idempotent same-binding, fresh state on new binding, web_push.binding_mismatch on identity change, legacy no-binding keeps subscriptions). AdvanceBadgeOnCompletion persists under store lock before send; dispatcher injects all-or-nothing badge tuple per subscription via marshalBadgePayload; register RPC accepts additive params.bindingId. Payload type gains badge/badgeBindingId/badgeRevision (omitempty).

verification.summary: web_push_badge_test.go: binding lifecycle, distinct-session counting, 999 cap, 4097 saturation (revision keeps advancing, existing keys still update), persist-failure omits tuple then converges, cross-restart persistence, corrupt-file isolation, unregister/device-delete cleanup, concurrent serialized monotonic revisions, bindingId format. Dispatcher per-device tuple injection (2 devices x 2 turns, real P-256 keys) and all-or-nothing marshaling. Contract tests assert badge tuple field-level (0..999, wpb_ format, decimal revision), register fixture bindingId, legacy no-binding validity, and web_push.binding_mismatch in canonical doc. Full repo go test ./... 20 packages pass; iOS mirror bun test 10/10.

todos.title: P4 badge RPC Service Worker and client lifecycle implementation
todos.description: Implement authenticated get/ack RPCs, binding mismatch behavior, Service Worker binding/revision watermark and dirty message, page single-flight get/ack lifecycle, and disable/rebind clearing semantics in remote-web.
todos.notes: No fallback, local counter, or silent-push path.

verification.summary: Go: BadgeStateView/AcknowledgeBadge store methods with stable error codes (binding_mismatch non-retryable, storage_failed retryable), get_push_badge_state/acknowledge_push_badge RPCs in handleWebPushRPC (web_push.manage scope, readable while misconfigured), PushBadgeStateResult with decimal revision and available-only count. iOS: SW parses the all-or-nothing badge tuple, claims revisions atomically in IndexedDB against the page-published active binding watermark (strictly newer only), calls setAppBadge with a number, swallows rejections without touching showNotification, and notifies windows CORDCODE_PUSH_BADGE_DIRTY_V1; push-manager generates bindingId per browser subscription (reused on reconcile), disable clears watermark + local badge, reconcileBadge runs single-flight get->ack with bounded saturated retries and advances the watermark to the ack-returned revision; AppController wires badge RPCs, DIRTY message, visibilitychange and post-hello triggers.

todos.title: P4 RPC and remote-web lifecycle tests
todos.description: Run focused Go and Vitest suites for authenticated device isolation, binding mismatch, throughRevision ack, saturation, out-of-order push suppression, old binding rejection, single-flight rerun, failures, and disable clearing.

verification.summary: Go: TestBadgeAcknowledgeSemantics (partial ack, idempotent re-ack, binding mismatch), TestBadgeAcknowledgeSaturatedOnlyClearsWhenStable, TestBadgeStateView, TestBadgeRPCGetAndAcknowledge/BindingMismatchStable/RequiresAuthAndValidParams, contract fixtures for both RPCs; full repo go test ./... 20 packages pass. iOS: sw-badge.test.ts (6 tests: valid tuple applies + watermark + dirty message, no-tuple untouched, 8 invalid/partial tuple shapes drop whole group but notification shows, out-of-order rev2>rev1 keeps rev2, old binding never touches badge, setAppBadge rejection keeps notification and watermark), push-badge.test.ts (9 tests: bindingId lifecycle, fresh-subscribe new binding + watermark reset, get->ack advances to returned revision, count 0 clears, saturated bounded 3 retries badge untouched, RPC failure leaves state untouched, disabled never re-arms, single-flight with deferred re-run, disable clears badge+watermark); push+protocol suites 70/70; full suite 88/89 files (relay failure pre-existing, missing WASM module, file untouched).
